method.normalisation: criterion_weight / max(1, sum(all included geographic criterion weights for the advertiser))
method.allocation: Normalised criterion budget distributed to mapped ZIP areas; 2020 ACS population for broader targets. Country-wide criteria are separate and off by default.
method.unknown: Unmapped and foreign criteria retain their share of the budget. They are never silently reallocated.
method.exclusions: Excluded criteria are kept in account detail and never counted as positive targets. A page can include and exclude the same place across different ads; exclusions cannot be applied globally without ad-level linkage.
method.districts: ZIP-area budgets divided by projected polygon intersection area across 120th Congress districts, January 1, 2026 vintage. This assumes uniform allocation within the ZIP area.
method.states: State amounts divide ZIP budgets by the summed district polygon intersection share within each state.
method.tagging: Primary All US taxonomy: Dems, DemPAC, Prog → Democratic aligned; GOP, RepPAC, Con → Republican aligned. Other primary labels stay Other. Accounts absent from All US stay unclassified.
method.deduplication: Repeated positive criteria are collapsed by advertiser, criterion type and value using the maximum reported spending weight.
method.currency: Only USD accounts enter the allocation model. Missing criterion weights receive no allocation.
